items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: And James P. took hold of the band.

ctx.x: He was the leader of the band?

Well, it was Charles Elgar's band. Elgar couldn't leave, you know, because he had too much. He had studio and different things there in Chicago. And James P. took hold of the band. He came. The whole band?
